organizer_or_author: Author experiment and author analysis rather than a hosted contest.

force_map.body: rear-frame seat attachment; inline Interface SSM-100 load cell, later ball joint and push/pull stick
force_map.observation: axial force; mostly lateral application; full world-coordinate force unobserved
force_map.source_code: RiderID/functions/davisbike.m, state=[roll rate, steer rate, roll, steer]; force map B_force=[M^-1 Hfw;0;0]
force_map.force_input: calibrated PullForce converted to newtons, multiply by -1 for run 184 exactly as davisdat.m
force_map.limitation: unmeasured rider lean, seat and foot reactions, departures from linear fixed-rider geometry, and off-axis load can violate first-row cancellation

speed.primary: scalar desired trial speed, not true instantaneous speed
speed.author_offline: mean of measured ForwardSpeed from the rear-wheel angular speed times negative wheel radius

scope: force-conditioned response on released synchronized channels; the author uses both accelerometers for alignment and evaluates a full-run force drift. No real-time acquisition claim.

direct_observed_defect.scope: no local assignment to v. The output estimate y is complete before this point. A one-line residual assignment is a separate repair.
